name: evh_match
description: eVHarmony v3 (round 17c, owner feedback): is this candidate a real vesicle? yes (Match) / no (Nope) / unsure (It's complicated: anything not clearly yes or no). v1's value names, so v1 answers carry over. After a Match, optional: kind single / multilayer (any part of one: outer ring or inner layer) and outline_off = yes (the right object, but its outline needs correcting). After It's complicated, optional: why faint / dense (small and dense) / edge (cut off at the edge) / other. consent as in v1: answered once per reviewer, on the set's first item only.

object_attrs.label: Match?
object_attrs.help: Swipe right = Match (a membrane-bound vesicle, overlapping ones too), left = Nope, up = It's complicated (anything not clearly yes or no).

object_attrs.label: What is it?
object_attrs.help: Only after a Match, optional. Multilayer: any part of one (outer ring, inner layer).

object_attrs.label: Outline off
object_attrs.help: Only after a Match, optional: the right object, but its outline needs correcting.

object_attrs.label: Count my answers
object_attrs.help: Asked once, on the set's first item: yes = these answers may be used.
